name: Suối Nước Ngọt
description: A quiet freshwater stream beside the coast, with shaded rocks and a peaceful picnic feel.
notes: Bring sandals, drinking water and a small towel.

name: Bãi Thùng
description: A wild beach with clear water and boulders that glow in the afternoon sun.
notes: Pack sun protection; facilities are limited.

name: Bãi Chuối
description: A small cove for an unhurried swim, away from the busiest route.
notes: Go early for the calmest water and cooler air.

name: Công viên Đá
description: Sculptural coastal rock formations with wide-open views for a memorable photo stop.
notes: Wear shoes with good grip on uneven rock.

name: Vịnh Vĩnh Hy boat day
description: A half-day boat ride for coral views, swimming and a fresh seafood lunch on the bay.
notes: Confirm boat departure with the local operator the day before.

name: Núi Langbiang
description: Fresh mountain air, pine views and a rewarding panorama above Đà Lạt.
notes: Bring a light jacket; the summit is windy.

name: Hồ Tuyền Lâm
description: A calm lake framed by pine trees, ideal for a gentle walk and a slow coffee.
notes: Late afternoon has the softest light for photos.

name: Café nhà kính Trại Mát
description: A warm local café stop in the hills, with greenhouse views and a quiet evening mood.
notes: Reserve a window table if visiting at sunset.

name: Hồ Hoàn Kiếm
description: Start the day around the lake, Ngọc Sơn Temple and the city’s most iconic walking loop.
notes: Arrive early for a cooler, quieter walk.

name: Phố cổ Hà Nội
description: Wander old lanes, browse small shops and pause for a bowl of local noodles.
notes: Carry small cash for street food and markets.

name: Làng gốm Bát Tràng
description: A creative half-day among pottery workshops, village lanes and hands-on ceramic making.
notes: Allow extra time if you want to paint your own piece.

name: Nhà tù Hỏa Lò
description: A focused museum visit that adds historical depth to a city discovery day.
notes: Dress respectfully and allow time to read the exhibits.
